record.paper_title: The average size of a connected vertex set of a graph-Explicit formulas and open problems
record.original_question: For connected finite graphs of order n, with D(G)=A(G)/n denoting the average size of a connected vertex set divided by n, is the path P_n the graph that minimizes D(G) among all graphs of order n?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6. Among all graphs of order n, the path minimizes the density.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a connected finite simple graph on $n$ vertices. A nonempty subset $S\subseteq V$ is called connected if the induced subgraph $G[S]$ is connected. Let $\mathcal{C}(G)$ denote the family of all nonempty connected vertex subsets of $G$, and define the average size of a connected vertex set by
$$A(G) \;=\; \frac{1}{|\mathcal{C}(G)|}\sum_{S\in\mathcal{C}(G)} |S|,$$
and the density by $D(G)=A(G)/n$. Let $P_n$ denote the path on $n$ vertices. Prove or disprove: for every connected graph $G$ on $n\geq 1$ vertices, 
$$D(G) \;\geq\; D(P_n),$$
i.e., $P_n$ minimizes the density $D$ among all connected graphs of order $n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (originally posed by Kroeker, Mol, and Oellermann, and restated as Conjecture 6 in Vince's paper) has been resolved. It was proved that among connected graphs of order n, the path uniquely minimizes the average order of connected induced subgraphs. Two independent proofs appeared nearly simultaneously: one by John Haslegrave ("The path minimises the average size of a connected induced subgraph," Discrete Mathematics, 2022) and one by Andrew Vince.

status_evidence.title: The path minimises the average size of a connected induced subgraph
status_evidence.snippet: Among connected graphs of order n, the path uniquely minimises the average order of its connected induced subgraphs, confirming a conjecture of Kroeker, Mol and Oellermann.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture that the path P_n minimizes the average order of connected induced subgraphs among connected graphs of order n has been proved.

status_evidence.title: A lower bound on the average size of a connected vertex set of a graph
status_evidence.snippet: Independent proof by Vince establishing the same minimization result.
status_evidence.claim: Vince independently proved the same lower bound, confirming the conjecture.
